p1.title: Passage 1
paras: In the age of algorithmic feeds and 15-second video loops, the cognitive landscape of childhood is undergoing a seismic shift. Deep reading—the immersive, sustained engagement with long-form text—is increasingly being replaced by “skimming” and “scanning.” This is not merely a change in format but a rewiring of neural circuitry. Deep reading fosters empathy, critical thinking, and the ability to hold complex, contradictory ideas simultaneously. Conversely, the fragmented consumption of digital media promotes a craving for immediate dopamine hits, eroding the patience required for narrative absorption. As children lose the capacity for “cognitive patience,” we risk raising a generation that is information-rich but context-poor, capable of processing data points but struggling to weave them into meaningful tapestries of understanding.

p2.title: Passage 2
paras: Education in early childhood profoundly shapes cognitive, social, and emotional development. Modern pedagogical approaches emphasize inquiry-based learning, critical thinking, and creativity rather than rote memorization. Exposure to diverse experiences, problem-solving tasks, and collaborative activities enhances adaptability and lifelong learning skills. However, disparities in access, quality of teaching, and socio-economic factors continue to hinder equitable development. Technology integration, including digital learning tools, offers opportunities for personalized education but can also exacerbate distraction and dependency if mismanaged. Parental involvement, teacher training, and culturally relevant curricula significantly influence outcomes. Research indicates that early interventions in literacy, numeracy, and socio-emotional skills have long-term benefits, impacting academic performance and personal growth. Consequently, a holistic approach combining pedagogy, infrastructure, technology, and social support is essential to nurture well-rounded learners.

questions.q: Priya is facing east. She turns 90 degrees clockwise, then 180 degrees, then 90 degrees anticlockwise. Which direction is she facing now?
questions.why: East, then clockwise to south, then about-turn to north, then anticlockwise to west.

questions.q: Sam bought 20 dozen toys at ₹375 a dozen and sold each toy for ₹33. What was his profit per cent?
questions.why: Cost per toy 375 ÷ 12 = 31.25; profit 1.75; 1.75 ÷ 31.25 = 5.6%. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. C is at the extreme left. A is third from the right end. B is to the immediate right of A. D sits next to both C and E. Who is at the extreme right?
questions.why: C is first, A fourth and B fifth. D must be second with E third, which leaves the sixth seat for F.

questions.q: In Kent's evaluation of mental symptoms, which group ranks highest?
opts: Symptoms of the will (loves, hates, emotions)

questions.q: Which pair are the chief anti-sycotic remedies?
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Thuja and Medorrhinum are the leading anti-sycotics.

questions.q: The return of old symptoms after a remedy is, according to Kent:
opts: a good sign that the disease is being cured
a sign the remedy was wrong
a reason to change the remedy at once
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Old symptoms reappearing means the cure is following the right direction; the remedy is left to act.

questions.q: Which remedy is described as the chronic of Ignatia?
questions.why: Natrum mur. is the chronic of Ignatia; both cover ailments from grief, with Natrum mur. for the deep, long-standing state.

questions.q: Bacillinum, a tubercular nosode, is especially used for:

opts: 4 mL × body weight (kg) × % burn in 24 hours, half in the first 8 hours

questions.q: Acute osteomyelitis in children most commonly affects the:

questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Medicolegally important in suicide, drowning and so on.

questions.q: Under the MTP (Amendment) Act 2021, the opinion of two registered doctors is needed for termination at (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. One doctor up to 20 weeks; a medical board beyond 24 weeks for fetal anomalies.

questions.q: Rigor mortis first appears in the:
opts: Myocardium (and then the eyelids and face)
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Heart first, then eyelids, face, and downward (Nysten's rule).
